conventions.regression: r ~ 1 + SPY + QQQ + SMH_orth (SMH residual on SPY, inside the window); Newey-West t, 5 lags; close-to-close ETF returns; raw (not excess) returns
conventions.states: computed from data known at the previous close (shift 1 session); VIX = FRED VIXCLS data/live/vix/VIXCLS.csv; SMH relative strength = 126-session return of SMH minus SPY; drawdowns from the running max since 2016-01-04 (panel start)
conventions.state_cell_ann_return: arithmetic mean daily return * 252 (cells are not contiguous)
conventions.stress_segment_rule: SPY close peak/trough within preset search windows; first return day is the session after the peak close; calendar segments use calendar dates
